race.comment: FLARESSENCE (11) didn't give her rivals a sniff last time at Eagle Farm when leading pillar-to-post. Expect the team to employ identical tactics and try and make all of the running. Think that they can pull it off. ESPERANZA (1) has put two on the bounce and beat a handful of these a month ago, but does concede a fair bit of weight to them now. Drops back in trip off a month in between and rates one of the key chances. FINAL CRUSADE (7) gets the most significant pull at the weights and has trialled strongly in-between runs. Blinkers go on to sharpen him up, and he can turn the tables. LUCKY PAT (2) comes through the same race where he was a beaten favourite but warmed nicely late. Is sure to have come on from that and is among the chances.
